---
title: "TAOOH — primary imputation"
subtitle: "50 multilevel weekly-state MICE branches"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

TAOOH uses exactly 50 one-imputation branches. The ordinal state is imputed
with multilevel PMM and then reconstructed into first- and second-order
histories; death is re-enforced as absorbing after each completed branch.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
if (!requireNamespace("miceadds", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'miceadds' is required for multilevel TAOOH imputation.")
library(miceadds)
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
if (length(indices) != 50L) stop("Primary TAOOH requires exactly 50 imputation branches.")
input_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "prepared.parquet")
branch_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "imputations"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "imputation.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: impute-taooh
#| include: false
prepared <- module_read_parquet(input_path)
module_require_columns(
  prepared,
  c("id", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein", "week", "y_taooh"),
  "prepared TAOOH data"
)
prepared$.cluster <- as.integer(factor(prepared$id))
init <- mice::mice(prepared, m = 0, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
methods <- init$method
predictors <- init$predictorMatrix
methods[] <- ""
methods["y_taooh"] <- "2l.pmm"
if ("ecog_fstcnt" %in% names(methods)) methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "2lonly.pmm"
if ("albumin" %in% names(methods)) methods["albumin"] <- "2lonly.pmm"
if ("c_reactive_protein" %in% names(methods)) methods["c_reactive_protein"] <- "2lonly.pmm"
if ("diagnosis" %in% names(methods)) methods["diagnosis"] <- "2lonly.pmm"
predictors[,] <- 0
predictors["y_taooh", c("week", "tx", "diagnosis", "ecog_fstcnt", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein")] <- 1
predictors["y_taooh", ".cluster"] <- -2
for (column in intersect(c("ecog_fstcnt", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein", "diagnosis"), rownames(predictors))) {
  predictors[column, c("tx", "week")] <- 1
  predictors[column, ".cluster"] <- -2
}
predictors[, c("id", ".cluster", "y", "yprev", "ypprev")] <- 0
predictors[c("id", ".cluster", "y", "yprev", "ypprev"), ] <- 0
validate_mice_spec(prepared, methods, predictors)

for (index in indices) {
  output_path <- file.path(branch_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-taooh-imputation-%02d", index),
    input_paths = input_path,
    output_paths = output_path,
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "taooh", imputation = index, m = 50L,
                   maxit = 50L, method = "multilevel PMM"),
    worker = function() {
      fitted <- mice::mice(
        data = prepared,
        method = methods,
        predictorMatrix = predictors,
        m = 1L,
        maxit = as.integer(config$imputation$main$maxit),
        donors = as.integer(config$imputation$main$donors),
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "imputation", index),
        printFlag = FALSE
      )
      completed <- mice::complete(fitted, action = 1L)
      completed$y <- as.integer(completed$y_taooh)
      completed <- completed |>
        dplyr::arrange(id, week) |>
        dplyr::group_by(id) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          death_seen = cumany(y == 5L),
          y = dplyr::if_else(death_seen, 5L, y),
          yprev = dplyr::lag(y, 1L, default = dplyr::first(y)),
          ypprev = dplyr::lag(y, 2L, default = dplyr::first(y))
        ) |>
        dplyr::ungroup()
      completed$death_seen <- NULL
      if (any(completed$y < 1L | completed$y > 5L, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Completed TAOOH states are outside 1:5.")
      completed$y <- factor(completed$y, levels = 1:5, ordered = TRUE)
      completed$yprev <- factor(completed$yprev, levels = 1:5, ordered = FALSE)
      completed$ypprev <- factor(completed$ypprev, levels = 1:5, ordered = FALSE)
      completed$.cluster <- NULL
      module_save_parquet(completed, output_path)
    }
  )
}
branch_paths <- file.path(branch_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", indices))
if (length(branch_paths) != 50L || !all(file.exists(branch_paths))) {
  stop("TAOOH imputation stage did not produce all 50 required branches.")
}
```
